method: Aligned full-canvas PNG exports; blue-key torso tint separation; original native Bean limbs and boots rasterized into matching detail, bare and mask layers.
limitations: Five supplied masters only. Bean limbs and boots retain native geometry. Other catalog choices remain SVG.

sources.name: body-bean
sources.prompt: Create one isolated transparent raster component-master for the DropInn player hero: the blue bean-shaped body only, on the complete shared square canvas. Match the approved Style A reference's whimsical MS Paint look: flat bright blue fill, thick irregular black raster contour, awkward hand-drawn asymmetry, sparse detail. Preserve the exact shared-canvas alignment and proportions from the body-bean.svg source and alignment-template.svg: body centered around x50-205 and y82-208 on a 256x256 canvas, leaving the face, hat, arms, hands, legs, and shoes absent so other modular layers can be assembled later. Do not add eyes, nose, mouth, hat, arms, legs, shoes, shadows, text, background, or extra layers. Image 1 is the approved Style A visual language only; body-bean.svg is the source identity and geometry; alignment-template.svg is the placement guide. Output must be a single clean transparent PNG component-master, not a finished character and not a flattened composite.
